integrity: The infinite statement is proved by a complete case analysis on empty core-leaf pairs. The standalone verifier independently simulates standard zero forcing and checks all subsets in a finite range. Prior corona bounds and the penta-sun example are explicitly attributed rather than presented as new.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the fully whiskered complete graph \(K_n\odot K_1\) for \(n\ge2\).
The finite exhaustive verification for \(2\le n\le8\) corroborates but does not prove the infinite theorem.
The claim does not extend to arbitrary base graphs, iterated coronas, or other zero forcing variants.
Poorly indexed work under uncommon names for the same graph family could remain undetected.
title: Zero forcing sets of fully whiskered complete graphs
